ideas.title: FBI Surveillance of Left-Leaning Groups: A Threat to Democracy?
ideas.description: Investigate the allegations of FBI surveillance of left-leaning groups in Minnesota and explore the potential implications for civil liberties and democratic institutions.
questions: What is the extent of FBI surveillance of left-leaning groups?
What are the potential implications for civil liberties and democratic institutions?
ideas.insight: This story has the potential to reveal significant government overreach and highlight the need for increased transparency and accountability. I recommend a thorough investigation into the allegations and a critical analysis of the potential implications.
